title: PUBG Mobile Revive Decisions: Cover, Smokes and Safe Resets
summary: Decide when a revive is realistic and how to avoid losing the whole squad.
intro: Decide when a revive is realistic and how to avoid losing the whole squad. This Digital Racer guide focuses on decisions a player can check in ordinary gameplay or through official settings, not secret unlocks or promises of certain results. Exact conditions depend on mode, device and current update, so begin with the rules and controls the game actually exposes. Aim for a repeatable process that improves awareness, safety and consistency instead of copying a single dramatic clip.

sections.heading: Identify the firing angle
paragraphs: Before approaching a knocked teammate, determine where the opponent fired from and whether that angle remains active. A revive in open ground can turn one knock into several. Use hard cover or create a protected route where possible.

sections.heading: Separate rescue from elimination
paragraphs: A nearby opponent may be baiting the revive. The safest play could be to suppress the threat, take a better position or delay the recovery attempt. Do not assume a teammate must be revived immediately in every fight.

sections.heading: Place smoke deliberately
paragraphs: Smoke should obstruct the most dangerous sightline and the approach path, not merely cover the knocked player's marker. It does not stop grenades or blind fire. Keep a teammate watching possible flanks while the revive progresses.

sections.heading: Call the recovery plan
paragraphs: One player should state who is reviving, who covers and which direction the group will leave afterward. Too many people clustering around a knock can make a single explosive decisive. Give short clear instructions rather than shouting conflicting orders.

sections.heading: Use the safe window
paragraphs: Listen for reloads, movement and changes in enemy pressure, but do not invent precise timing rules that cannot be guaranteed. If the cover collapses or the circle forces movement, abandon a nonviable attempt before the whole squad is trapped.

sections.heading: Review the alternative
paragraphs: After a match, ask whether the original knock occurred outside support range and whether emergency utility was available. Better squad spacing can prevent some desperate revive situations. A failed rescue does not necessarily mean the teammate who tried lacked courage.

sections.heading: Apply this method and compare results
paragraphs: For a useful trial, choose a comparable match scenario and identify the first decision you can control. Keep teammates informed and favor hard cover over a dramatic shortcut. If opponents behave differently, adapt to their actual angles and timing rather than forcing a scripted tactic. Review one avoidable mistake afterwards. The objective is a decision process that works across many lobbies, not a highlight clip or a supposed guaranteed result.

sections.heading: A practical review after the next session
paragraphs: Return to the central goal of pubg mobile revive decisions: cover, smokes and safe resets. Identify which of the six decisions you genuinely used and what made them difficult. Decide when a revive is realistic and how to avoid losing the whole squad. Compare your first attempt with two later attempts while keeping the main conditions similar. If you cannot explain why one choice helped, treat the result as uncertain. Write down a smaller next adjustment, preserve existing safe settings and let the current game's rules determine which tactics remain valid.
